dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL dialect used in the ORCA project. Program ORCGW96 handles CRON job scheduling settings in the system management subsystem.
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA SPAAREA LINKAREA SCRAREA
no EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (claims) processing system - system management CRON scheduling configuration screen
purpose.summary: ORCGW96 is a screen program within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software that manages CRON job scheduling settings. It initialises and displays a scheduling configuration screen (W96), reads CRON job records from the database, populates combo-box lists for day-of-week, month, day-of-month, and hour, and handles user input events for editing CRON entries.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (64 copybooks) for screen layouts and shared areas
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple passed areas (MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA)
MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT driven event loop (ORCA MCP framework, not CICS)
Japanese EUC/Latin-1 encoded comments and string literals
OCCURS tables for CRON schedule entries and combo-box lists
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for screen navigation
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
Fixed-format source with lines up to 74 chars
verdict.notes: File is encoded in Latin-1 but contains EUC-JP Japanese text in comments and string literals, causing mojibake in the excerpt. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA project. program_type is set to online-cics as the closest enum match, but the actual framework is the ORCA MCP (Message Control Program) GUI framework, not CICS.
